description: Centralized, deterministic scoring rules, weights, normalizations, and tier bands for Chit Credit Score.

normalization_conventions.note: Implementation convention: The blueprint specifies weights w1=0.5, w2=0.2, w3=0.2, w4=0.1 on mixed-scale inputs without specifying individual scaling. Normalization caps streak and tenure at 10 cycles mapped to a 0-100 scale, and scales missed payments by 10 points per missed payment.

tier_bands.description: Insufficient on-time history or high missed payments; below credit unlock threshold
Emerging credit history with solid foundation
Consistent track record of timely chit contributions
Flawless payment discipline, high streak and mature tenure
